import sys,os,json,pathlib,hashlib,stat
home=pathlib.Path('/home/kali/.hermes')
source=home/'hermes-agent'
violations=[]
allowed_dirs={str(home/x) for x in ('','cron','sessions','logs','logs/curator','memories','pairing','hooks','image_cache','audio_cache','skills')}
def refuse(reason):
    violations.append(reason)
    os.write(2, ('GUARD:'+reason+'\n').encode())
    raise PermissionError('SCOPED_READ_ONLY_GUARD')
def audit(event,args):
    if event=='open':
        path=args[0]
        if isinstance(path,(str,bytes,os.PathLike)):
            text=os.fsdecode(path); parts=pathlib.Path(text).parts; base=pathlib.Path(text).name.lower()
            if base.startswith('.env') or base=='auth.json' or base.startswith('credentials') or 'tokenstore' in base or base in ('tokens.json','token.json'):
                refuse('credential_file_open')
            if '/home/kali/.hermes/profiles/' in text:
                refuse('other_profile_open')
        mode=args[1]; flags=args[2]
        if (isinstance(mode,str) and any(x in mode for x in 'wax+')) or (isinstance(flags,int) and flags & (os.O_WRONLY|os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_APPEND)):
            refuse('file_write')
    elif event.startswith('socket.') or event in ('subprocess.Popen','os.system','os.fork','os.forkpty','os.posix_spawn','os.posix_spawnp','pty.spawn') or event.startswith('os.exec') or event.startswith('os.spawn'):
        refuse('network_or_subprocess')
    elif event=='os.mkdir':
        p=os.fsdecode(args[0])
        if p not in allowed_dirs or not pathlib.Path(p).is_dir(): refuse('directory_create')
    elif event in ('os.chmod','os.chown','os.remove','os.unlink','os.rmdir','os.rename','os.link','os.symlink','os.truncate','os.utime'):
        refuse('filesystem_mutation')
sys.addaudithook(audit)
sys.path.insert(0,str(source))
r={'result':'NOT_RUN','guard_installed_before_native_imports':True,'flags':{'isolated':sys.flags.isolated,'dont_write_bytecode':sys.dont_write_bytecode},'home_override':str(home)}
try:
    import agent.prompt_builder as pb
    origin=pathlib.Path(pb.__file__).resolve()
    expected=(source/'agent/prompt_builder.py').resolve()
    assert origin==expected
    r['native_loader_origin']=str(origin)
    r['native_loader_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(origin.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    r['native_callable']='agent.prompt_builder.load_soul_md'
    content=pb.load_soul_md(context_length=None,home_override=home)
    expected_text=(home/'SOUL.md').read_text().strip()
    r['returned_exact_soul_strip']=content==expected_text
    markers=('Honor the latest requested deliverable before acting or delegating.','Delayed child results do not revive stopped work.','developers write and fix product code','independent reviewers assess frozen bytes','QA exercises the affected real artifact after blocking findings clear','these working-style instructions do not guarantee automatic future compliance')
    r['new_ceiling_and_role_marker_checks']=[bool(content and s in content) for s in markers]
    r['loaded_soul_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest() if content else None
    r['result']='PASS' if r['returned_exact_soul_strip'] and all(r['new_ceiling_and_role_marker_checks']) and not violations else ('BLOCKED' if violations else 'FAIL')
except BaseException as exc:
    r['result']='BLOCKED' if violations else 'NOT_RUN'
    r['exception_type']=type(exc).__name__
    if isinstance(exc,ModuleNotFoundError): r['missing_module']=exc.name
r['guard_attempts']=violations
print(json.dumps(r))
sys.exit(0 if r['result']=='PASS' else 3)
